parts.text: Create a 10-slide pitch deck for a SaaS product targeting small businesses. Include speaker notes.

property.description: The agent calls build_presentation exactly once with an appropriate title, theme, summary, and all 10 slides in one ordered array.
The first created slide is a title slide, followed by focused content or bullet slides.
Slides are focused on one main idea each, use 3-6 bullet points where appropriate, and include useful speaker notes.
The agent reports completion only when build_presentation succeeds with a persisted slide_count of 10.
